Category II AIF

Real Estate Funds

Accessing premium commercial, residential, and logistics real estate through professionally managed pooled investment vehicles with institutional-grade governance.

Definition & Purpose

Real Estate AIFs pool capital from sophisticated investors to acquire, develop, and manage income-generating real estate assets. These funds provide access to large-ticket institutional real estate deals — premium office parks, warehousing hubs, and residential townships — that are typically inaccessible to individual investors due to capital requirements and complexity.

Residential Development

Mid to premium residential projects in high-demand micro-markets with strong absorption rates.

Why Real Estate AIFs?

Inflation Hedge

Real estate values and rents tend to rise with inflation, providing natural protection for long-term capital.

Rental Income

Regular distribution from rental yields, providing predictable cash flow alongside capital appreciation.

Low Correlation

Real estate returns have low correlation with equity markets, improving overall portfolio risk-adjusted returns.

Leverage Benefits

Prudent use of debt financing (LTV 50–60%) amplifies equity returns while asset collateral provides downside protection.
